message: I was under the impression that cigarette companies were trying very hard to get new customers, keep present ones, and keep their product a good one. You have a "Seal of Excellence" on the top of Dorals — that I find a disappointment to me as of this week. I bought a carton of Doral Ultra Light — non menthol — Kings this week & out of the pack I have opened & tried to smoke — I find cigarettes that taste like "MOLD!" I am sending you one of them! I think I wasted my money. I am enclosing the UPC from the carton in hopes that it will help you figure out the problem & improve your quality of this product.
